activation.description: Cognia never fires these, so the extension does not start for them. It still starts for its other activation events.
activation.title: Activation events.

apis.description: Calls to these fail or do nothing, and the extension's log says why. Found by scanning the extension's code, which can miss calls in minified code.
apis.title: VS Code APIs.

debuggers.description: Cognia has no debugger, so its debug configurations and breakpoints are not available.
debuggers.title: Debuggers.

editorGrammars.description: Its syntax coloring applies to code in chat and previews, not in the code editor.
editorGrammars.title: Syntax grammars.

esmBundle.description: The extension is an ES module. Cognia, like VS Code 1.91, runs extensions as CommonJS, so it cannot start.
esmBundle.title: ES module.

extensionPack.description: The extensions this pack lists are not installed with it. Install the ones you want separately.
extensionPack.title: Extension pack.

keybindings.description: Its keyboard shortcuts are not bound. Run its commands from the command lists.
keybindings.title: Keyboard shortcuts.

menus.description: Its entries in context menus and title bars are not shown. Run its commands from the command lists.
menus.title: Menus.

notebooks.description: Cognia has no notebooks, so its notebook types and renderers are not available.
notebooks.title: Notebooks.

views.description: Its tree views, view containers and welcome content are not shown. Its webview views appear in the extension rail.
views.title: Views.

description: Parts of this VS Code extension that Cognia does not provide. The rest of the extension works as usual.
title: Not available in Cognia
